title: Spec review-order still says the draft expiry sweep covers archived vacancies (removed by the W4 fix)
evidence:
spec line 245: "- Expiry sweep phase: closed, archived, or past closes_at." — but server/src/retention/sql/delete_expired_application_drafts.sql now reads: "WHERE d.vacancy_id = v.id
  AND (
    v.status = 'closed'
    OR (v.closes_at IS NOT NULL AND v.closes_at <= now())
  )" with header comment "Archived vacancies keep their drafts: archiving is restorable (AGENTS.md), the emailed promise is \"until the vacancy closes\""
detail: The Perkins-r1 W4 fix (archive no longer sweeps drafts) made this Suggested Review Order line stale; the spec change log records W4 but the navigation line still misdescribes the shipped sweep.
recommended_fix: Edit the review-order line to "Expiry sweep phase: closed or past closes_at (archived vacancies keep drafts per W4)".
